We got two templates. Choose one with reaction_id 316813. Template ID maybe we need to use template_id as string? The tool expects template_id string. We'll use "316813". Good.

Now need esterification template: functional groups formed: "carboxylic esters"; broken: "alcohol" and "carboxylic acid"? Actually esterification forms ester from alcohol and carboxylic acid, breaking OH of acid and H of alcohol. So functional_groups_formed: ["carboxylic esters"]; broken: ["aliphatic hydroxyls", "aliphatic carboxylic acid"] maybe.
